newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks narrowly mixed in London, awaiting PPI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks narrowly mixed in London, awaiting PPI.

text.p: U.S. shares were narrowly mixed in London as investors awaited the 1230 GMT release of key U.S. inflation data, dealers said.
The open on Wall Street will be heavily influenced by the April producer price index, dealers said.
"The (S&P 500) futures are as volatile as the overall market has been," said one dealer. "The open will depend on the PPI."

The PPI, which is expected to show no change in April, and the consumer price index, due on Thursday, are the last two important economic statistics to be released before the Federal Reserve's May 20 policy meeting.
